chapter: Casa, Zeb Lenard and Little Joe
title: Teaching Little Joe the trumpet, and his later troubles
summary: Vincent taught the 14-year-old Little Joe to play horn by picking his banjo, within four months Joe could blow. He tells of Joe's marijuana and whiskey habits, his later breakdown and turn to preaching, and chats about where they live.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road
